name: @darkbear9494/dsh-model-manager
description: Role-based model manager for DeepSeek Harness: assign models to planning, execution, vision and main roles, route subagent work by role, escalate sessions that invoke a planning skill (grilling / grill-me) to the planning role, report which model every subagent used, prompt the top-level agent to delegate, ship a /autoplan skill that plans on the planning tier then implements on main without stopping for approval, and switch models through agent.model.select() on DSH 0.2.x, and check npm for updates.

meta.title: Model manager
meta.description: Assign models to planning, execution, vision and main roles, see which model each subagent used, auto-delegate, run /autoplan (plan on the planning tier, then implement on main without an approval gate), and get update notices.
